package rulefixtures

// scenario for map_delete_in_loop_vs_new_map: `for k := range m { delete(m, k) }` patterns
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.

func scenario615Positive(rounds int) map[string]int {
	m := make(map[string]int)
	for i := 0; i < rounds; i++ {
		m["a"] = 1
		m["b"] = 2
		for k := range m {
			delete(m, k)
		}
	}
	return m
}
